# Health Databases

This folder catalogs national clinical quality databases established to monitor, evaluate, and improve specific treatment pathways within the Danish healthcare system. It currently houses the central registry for inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), documenting its operational launch, patient inclusion criteria, clinical quality indicators, and governance structure under the RKKP framework.

## Pages

- [[dansk-kvalitetsdatabase-for-inflammatoriske-tarmsygdomme|Dansk Kvalitetsdatabase for Inflammatoriske Tarmsygdomme]] — The national registry (DANIBD) tracking diagnostic workups, surgical outcomes, and medical therapies for patients with Crohn's disease, ulcerative colitis, and related conditions.
